Notes
Comis Hotel & Golf Resort – Santon, Isle of Man
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Hours: Full-Time | Permanent

We are looking for an experienced Spa Manager or a Senior Beauty/Spa Therapist who is ready to take the next step into management to join Comis Hotel & Golf Resort.
This is an excellent opportunity for either an established Spa Manager or an experienced Senior Therapist with strong leadership potential who is looking to progress their career.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate and develop our team of Spa Therapists.
Deliver professional spa treatments to a high technical standard.
Manage bookings, rotas, scheduling and daily spa operations.
Drive treatment, retail and revenue performance.
Monitor costs, targets and departmental KPIs.
Maintain excellent guest service, cleanliness and presentation standards.
Ensure compliance with health & safety and company procedures.
Support the promotion of spa services, offers and social media activity.

About You
NVQ Level 3 Beauty/Spa Therapy qualification or equivalent – essential.
Experience as a Spa Manager, Spa Supervisor or Senior Beauty/Spa Therapist.
Strong practical treatment skills and a passion for wellness and guest care.
Leadership experience or the confidence and ability to take the next step into a management role.
Commercial awareness and the ability to work towards treatment, retail and revenue targets.
Excellent communication, organisation and people skills.
Confident using booking and scheduling systems.
Flexible to work weekends and variable hours as required.
Knowledge of Elemis products would be advantageous.

What We Offer
Competitive salary based on experience.
Service charge participation.
Relocation assistance.
Staff meals and uniform.
Hotel and staff discounts.
Recognition and reward schemes.
Free on-site parking.
Training and career development opportunities.

The opportunity to progress into spa management and develop your leadership career.

To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to HR@comishotel.com.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the Isle of Man.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

STRICTLY NO AGENCIES

Notes
We are seeking an experienced, reliable and highly organised Private Housekeeper to join a busy family household in Douglas.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who takes genuine pride in maintaining a home to an exceptional standard and enjoys a varied role where they can work independently and take ownership of their responsibilities.

The position is within a large private family home and will involve high-standard housekeeping and cleaning, laundry and ironing, clothing care, preparation and organisation of school uniforms, changing beds and managing household linen, keeping wardrobes, cupboards and household areas organised, grocery shopping, managing household supplies and deliveries, and some light household administration.

We are looking for someone who is naturally proactive and organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to recognise what needs to be done without requiring constant direction.

Discretion and trustworthiness are extremely important. The successful candidate will be respectful of the family's privacy, dependable, professional and comfortable working independently within a private home.

Previous experience within a private household, professional housekeeping, hotel housekeeping or a high-standard domestic environment would be highly desirable.

We are happy to consider different working patterns and can offer flexibility around hours for the right person. However, availability for a half-day on Saturday is essential.

A full driving licence is essential due to the nature of the position.

Applicants must have the appropriate right or permission to work in the Isle of Man, or be able to obtain any permission required for the role.
To apply, please send your CV to allison@trillionmediagroup.com

Notes
Please apply only for the role here - https://careers.dandara.com/jobs/8489693-data-protection-compliance-officer

Working closely with the Group Compliance Manager, you’ll become a trusted point of contact for teams across Dandara, helping them understand their obligations and turn complex requirements into straightforward processes, controls and actions.

A significant part of your role will focus on data protection and information governance, including UK GDPR, DPIAs, DSARs, Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), data breaches, retention and supplier compliance.

But your remit will be broader than GDPR alone.

You'll also gain exposure to Group risk management, information security, consumer compliance, property and lettings regulation, financial crime controls and assurance activity across a diverse and growing property business.

About you

You'll be someone who sees good compliance as an enabler rather than a barrier.

You're comfortable working with detail but can also step back, understand the commercial objective and explain risk in straightforward language. When faced with a difficult question, your instinct is to understand what the business is trying to achieve and find a compliant route to get there.

You'll also be confident enough to challenge when necessary and explain clearly when a proposed approach creates unacceptable risk.

You'll ideally bring:

Experience within data protection, compliance, risk, governance, audit, legal or controls.

A good working knowledge of UK GDPR and data protection, including DPIAs, DSARs, RoPA, breaches, retention and processor oversight.

Experience maintaining compliance registers, action plans, policies, procedures and evidence.

An understanding of information security and the relationship between cyber security and data protection risk.

The ability to interpret regulatory or legal requirements and turn them into practical business processes.

Strong written communication and drafting skills.

Excellent organisation and attention to detail.

Confidence working with stakeholders at different levels of an organisation.

A practical, commercial and solution-focused mindset.

Notes
We’re looking for an experienced and motivated fitness coach to join the team at FitBody Fitness, delivering high-quality small group personal training sessions to our members.

The main focus of the role is coaching small groups through structured, progressive programming, making sure every client trains safely, stays motivated, and keeps moving towards their goals session after session. You’ll also be responsible for inducting new members, taking them through their initial assessments, and helping them settle in so they feel confident and supported from day one.

Just as important is the work that happens between sessions, with regular check-ins to keep clients accountable on their training, nutrition, and lifestyle, building the kind of relationships that keep people engaged and coming back.

The ideal candidate holds a recognised Level 3 personal training qualification, has genuine experience coaching groups rather than only one-to-one, and brings the energy, reliability, and communication skills needed to lead a room full of different abilities. You’ll need to be organised, personable, and genuinely invested in getting results for the people you coach.
To apply, send your CV along with a short note about your coaching experience and why you’d be a good fit for FitBody Fitness to fitbodyfitness.im@hotmail.com.

Notes
The Warehouse Supervisor is a key leadership role that bridges the gap between our transport office, 
warehouse floor, and Class 2 drivers.  In this position, you will assume full operational accountability for the physical movement of goods, warehouse efficiency, and the strategic management of both the administrative and delivery drivers. You will be responsible for coordinating, scheduling, delivering island wide and managing our team of drivers and handling warehouse stock control. This is a hands-on management role that requires both strategic problem-solving and excellent interpersonal skills to resolve customer queries and 
lead your team effectively. 

Key Responsibilities :
Directly manage, shift-schedule, and train warehouse administrators and delivery drivers. 
Plan and schedule daily delivery runs across the Isle of Man, maximizing fuel efficiency and 
timing accuracy. 
Establish operational goals, evaluate team performance, and build a culture of safety and 
accountability. 
Strategically align the daily delivery booking schedule with physical warehouse capacity and 
staffing levels. 
Coordinate with the transport team to ensure incoming stock is processed, inspected, and 
allocated correctly. 
Act as the main escalation point for customer inquiries, delivery delays, or challenges. 
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between system records and physical warehouse 
stock. 
Supervise the physical staging and secure loading of home delivery vehicles to ensure transit 
safety and zero-damage delivery. 
Oversee the dispatch process to guarantee on-time departures and strict adherence to 
customer delivery windows.

Qualifications & Skills Required: 
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in logistics, transport management, or warehouse operations. 
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to lead by example, diffuse stressful situations, and maintain high team morale. 
Ability to assist with manual handling and lifting of heavy, bulky items when operational demands require a hands-on approach. 
Forklift licence (Desirable).

For more details and to apply contact Gabbie@mic.co.im

We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member.
South of the Island - Please note that you must have your own transport for our remote location.

vacancies@bdc.im

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 25-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
Own transport: Essential.
What You'll Be Doing
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im 

We can't wait to welcome the right person to the team!

We are looking for an experienced, caring and reliable Nanny to join a busy family on the Isle of Man.

The family has six children, with the youngest aged 2 and at home during the day. The role will focus on caring for the youngest child during school hours, while also supporting the wider family routine before and after school.

The preferred schedule is Monday to Friday, 7am–7pm, one week on / one week off, although alternative hours may be considered for the right candidate.

Duties include childcare, school and activity routines, preparing children's meals, laundry and general household organisation.

We are looking for someone warm, patient and organised with previous professional childcare or nannying experience. Childcare qualifications, paediatric first aid and a full driving licence would be advantageous.

Competitive salary depending on experience and agreed working pattern.

To apply email jo@recruitmentworks.im or call 629 676

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team. The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times. Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience. Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position. Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities. Why Join Prospero Group? We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave. Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us. To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Notes
We are hiring two Software Engineers.

Phantom Studios (Phantom Ltd) is the Isle of Man software studio behind PhantomTrace and our KYC AI platform. We work alongside our sister companies Advantyx (forensic accounting) and Odin Fiduciaries (corporate services). We build software for forensics, KYC and compliance, and fraud work, and we also take on software work for eGaming companies. This is a small team, so what you build ships and gets used.

Both posts are the same role. We are growing the engineering side and there is more work than one person can carry. You will own projects, not tickets. You take something from a rough idea to a running thing people rely on, and you keep it running.

We build with AI agents every day. Claude Code is central to how we work, so this role sits right in the middle of that.

What you'll do:

Build and own some of our projects end to end: backend, deployment, and the day-to-day of keeping them healthy.
Design systems that are simple to run and simple for the next person to read.
Work with AI agents as a normal part of how you build, and know when to trust them and when not to.
Integrate with third-party services (KYC providers, payment and gaming platforms, forensic data sources).
Pick up whatever the project needs, including bits of frontend, data work, and infrastructure.

What you need:

Strong backend engineering in at least one language, and the sense to pick the right tool rather than the familiar one.
Cloud and deployment. You can put a service into production and look after it, not just write the code.
Solid grounding in system design and engineering principles. You think about failure, data, and maintenance before you think about frameworks.
Fluent with agentic development. You have built real things with coding agents (Claude Code or similar) and you understand context management, skills and subagents, prompting, and orchestration. You have a view on where they help and where they get in the way.
API design and integration. Clean interfaces, sensible contracts, third-party services wired in without drama.

Nice to have:

Enough frontend and UI sense to build a decent interface, even if you are not a frontend specialist.
Comfortable across several languages, for example Python, Go, or Java, and happy to pick up whatever a project calls for.
Application security, and care when handling sensitive data.
Any exposure to forensics, compliance, fraud, or eGaming. Not required, we will teach the domain.

Swagelok Ltd

Tool Maker (Twilight Shift)

We are Hiring!

We are looking for an experienced Tool Maker on our twilight shift

Twilight shift (11 am – 21.00 pm working Monday to Thursday)

Toolmaker (Manual Machining & Tool Regrinding)

We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated Toolmaker with a strong background in manual machining and tool reconditioning. This role is focused on precision work using manual lathes and milling machines, alongside surface grinding, tool regrinding, and heat treatment processes.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship and the ability to interpret engineering drawings accurately, while engaging proactively with internal customers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Manufacture, modify, and repair tooling using manual lathes, milling machines, and grinders.
Independently, re-grind a wide range of cutting tools, including drills, reamers, and similar end-working tools, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.
Perform heat treatment processes as required to support tooling performance and longevity.
Carry out maintenance repairs to jigs, make new fixtures, gauges, and other tooling.
Set up and operate all relevant machine tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify and resolve non-routine tooling or machining issues.
Work collaboratively with customers and colleagues to develop practical and cost-effective solutions.
Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in traditional toolmaking, with a focus on manual machining processes.
Proven ability to re-grind and restore a variety of cutting tools independently.
Competence in surface grinding and heat treatment techniques.
Excellent understanding of engineering drawings, tolerances, and materials.
Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Additional Requirements

Adheres to all plant regulatory and safety requirements.
Supports the company operating plan and aligns with Swagelok’s mission, vision, and values.
About You

This opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional who takes pride in their work, thrives in a team environment, and consistently delivers high standards in customer service, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

To apply please visit our recruitment portal at http://iomjobs.swagelok.com

Swagelok Ltd.
Maintenance Housekeeper.
Swagelok is a global engineering company, manufacturing a wide range of high-quality components to a world market, which offers a competitive benefits package for all employees.
Due to continued growth in our Isle of Man site, we are looking for a maintenance housekeeper to join our facilities and maintenance department.
The successful candidates will be responsible for following the company’s general housekeeping and safety practices & policies. They will also be required to independently identify and perform general cleaning for their areas of responsibility.
Additional tasks include supporting our maintenance technicians with general upkeep of our facility including CNC machining centres, assisting with machine moves and installation of new equipment.
As a customer facing site, we require the successful candidate to show close attention to detail, to take pride in their work and ensure a high standard is maintained in all aspects of their roll.
It is preferred that the applicant; holds a counterbalance forklift licence, has experience with food & hygiene in the workplace and is manual handling trained.
The roll can be physical demanding and an applicant must be capable of being on their feet for up to 8- hours a day. Lift, push, pull or carry weight no more than 35lbs, as well as squat bend and reach.
This exciting opportunity would suit an individual who thrives in a team environment, whilst achieving high standards of customer service, quality, and cost effectiveness.
If you are interested in applying for this role, please visit our online portal at http://iomjobs.Swagelok.com

You will assist the Audit Manager in planning and executing audit processes, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial records. This role involves supporting the audit team, conducting audits, and helping to develop audit strategies.

Assist in planning, coordinating, and executing internal and external audits.
Support daily audit operations and ensure compliance with auditing standards.
Review and analyse financial statements, budgets, and forecasts.

Assist in managing and mentoring the audit team.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
High attention to detail.

ACCA or ACA qualified or equivalent professional certification. 
Proficient in accounting software, Word, Excel and Outlook.

Join us as Senior Customer Service Advisor at Barclays, to provide resolutions for customer queries/issues and personalise each interaction through the use of multiple communication channels.

Strong awareness of risk and control to support the completion of high-value transaction approvals, payment investigations and complaints where risk issues arise.
Support leadership with the delivery of service levels, change implementation, driving a culture of continuous improvement whilst supporting colleagues with complex issues and escalations.
Support embedment and upskilling of newly recruited colleagues and identify opportunities to become multi-skilled in role to support the delivery of a consistently excellent service across all channels of engagement.

Experience leading or holding a senior role within a service centre environment.

You'll also support statutory reporting, filings and audits, working in line with accounting standards, company policy and reporting deadlines.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a solid grounding in finance who is keen to build their experience in a varied and supportive environment.

Notes
We are seeking an Audit Assistant Manager to join our growing Audit team in the Crown Dependencies. The successful candidate will report directly to a Manager or Senior Manager and work closely with colleagues across service lines to deliver high quality outcomes for our clients.
This role offers the opportunity to:
Work with a diverse portfolio of clients, including funds, banking, insurance, corporate and private clients.
Contribute to technically complex and commercially significant engagements.
Develop your career in a high performance, supportive and growth-focused environment.
Be part of an audit practice that aspires to be a market leader in the Crown Dependencies, helping clients navigate regulatory environments and establish meaningful, practical business solutions.
Build a future-proofed career through exposure to cutting edge practices and technologies supporting ambitious growth targets.

Key Responsibilities
As an Audit Assistant Manager, you will:
Be the main point of contact for your portfolio of clients, developing excellent knowledge of their operations and the external/internal market factors that affect them.
Build deep, meaningful client relationships.
Ensure the timely delivery of engagements through effective planning and project management, escalating concerns early.
Effectively utilise resources to deliver excellent service and drive efficiency.
Coach, mentor and develop peers and junior team members.
Develop and maintain strong working relationships across KPMG in the Crown Dependencies and the wider KPMG network.
Proactively seek quality feedback to support your professional development and encourage others to do the same.

Requirements
We are looking to engage with candidates who have:
Time and exam qualified accountant status (ACA, ACCA or equivalent).
At least 3 years’ experience in an external financial statements audit role.
Experience leading audits from planning through to completion.
Financial Services audit experience (including Asset Management) is an advantage, but not essential.
Up to date technical knowledge of accounting and financial reporting standards including IFRS and/or UK GAAP.
Strong English communication skills (spoken, listening and written).
Strong IT literacy, including Excel and Word.
Strong project management capabilities including decision making, critical thinking, analytical skills, time management, prioritisation and organisation.
Demonstrable experience coaching junior team members and peers.

To apply please go to the below website
https://kpmg.peoplehr.net/Pages/JobBoard/Opening.aspx?v=82dfd33a-cb24-4f9e-b5ca-4835322ed323

Notes
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join our newly formed Isle of Man team. This role focuses on maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day transactions, and ensuring compliance across a group of trading companies. 
Reporting directly to the Accounts Manager the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the finance function, delivering timely reconciliations, and enabling informed decision-making.
Primary responsibilities: Maintain accurate financial records for three active trading companies, ensuring all entries are complete and compliant with internal policies and relevant accounting standards. Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations, resolving discrepancies promptly. Process accounts payable and receivable, ensuring timely supplier payments and accurate client invoicing. Prepare and post journals for accruals, prepayments, and other adjustments. Manage intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and currency transfers. Support month-end and year-end close processes, including the preparation of management accounts and reports for the Financial Director. Assist with VAT and other statutory filings, liaising with external advisors as necessary. Monitor cash flow and provide forecasts to support operational planning. Maintain organised digital and physical financial documentation. Support internal and external audit requirements by providing accurate records and explanations.
Key competencies and behaviours: CAT qualified (or equivalent) or working towards a recognised accounting qualification, with potential support for ACCA study if desired. Proven accounting experience, ideally across multiple trading companies or group structures. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial reporting. Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively across teams and with external partners. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
To apply, please send your CV to grant.cairney@brightsideserv.com. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the Isle of Man or UK as Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Notes
Our client seeks an experienced and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join their team. This role focuses on maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day transactions, and ensuring compliance across a group of trading companies. Reporting directly to the Accounts Manager the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the finance function, delivering timely reconciliations, and enabling informed decision-making. Key Responsibilities: Maintain accurate financial records for three active trading companies, ensuring all entries are complete and compliant with internal policies and relevant accounting standards. Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations, resolving discrepancies promptly. Process accounts payable and receivable, ensuring timely supplier payments and accurate client invoicing. Prepare and post journals for accruals, prepayments, and other adjustments. Manage intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and currency transfers. Support month-end and year-end close processes, including the preparation of management accounts and reports for the Financial Director. Assist with VAT and other statutory filings, liaising with external advisors as necessary. Monitor cash flow and provide forecasts to support operational planning. Maintain organised digital and physical financial documentation. Support internal and external audit requirements by providing accurate records and explanations. Key Skills and Experience: CAT qualified (or equivalent) or working towards a recognised accounting qualification, with potential support for ACCA study if desired. Proven accounting experience, ideally across multiple trading companies or group structures. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial reporting. Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively across teams and with external partners. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16836

Our client seeks a Client Accountant to join their team. Role Profile To play a full role as a member of the Finance Team, taking responsibility for the accounting requirements of a portfolio of captive insurance clients, with the opportunity to participate in Board-level activities and meetings. While experience in insurance or captives is an advantage, it is not essential. Key Responsibilities. As a Client Accountant, you will act as a key point of contact for your clients and play a central role in coordinating internal and external stakeholders. Working with the Captive Insurance Team to prepare monthly or quarterly management accounts including commentary and preparing semi-annual or annual regulatory returns. Preparing statutory accounts and acting as the key contact for external auditors, ensuring audits are completed within agreed timescales. Preparation of Isle of Man tax returns and IPT returns. Review and monitor cash levels on a regular basis. Liaison with the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority (IOMFSA) and shareholder representatives where necessary. Preparation of additional key management information for clients such as regular forecasts and annual budgeting and ad-hoc solvency calculations. With support where required, advise senior management on the financial impact of decisions and present financial information at Board level. Contributing to the development of financial systems and processes. Participating in regulatory and accounting standards driven projects as required from time to time. Key Skills and Experience. Ability to work in a fast-paced, professional environment and takes pride in delivering excellent client service. Essential skills and experience. Professionally qualified (or time-served for the right candidate). Day-to-day, first-hand experience of producing management and statutory accounts. Working to client and regulatory driven deadlines and organising various stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Desirable (but not essential). Experience in insurance, captives, or risk management. Experience working in a regulated or professional services environment. Exposure to Board or senior management reporting. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16814

Our client seeks a Part-Time - Accountant to join their team. (Between 25 to 30 hours per week - Flexible) Role Profile Forming part of an experienced team at a small Office, the successful applicant will take day to day responsibility for a number of companies and trusts and various reporting processes, in addition to the compilation of management accounts on a quarterly basis. Preparation of annual financial statements may also be required, however guidance in this area will be provided where necessary. Key Responsibilities. The primary objective of the role will be to work within the accounting team to ensure the requisite accounting and administrative processes are completed for a small number of companies and trusts. Processing of payments and liaising with banks accordingly. Bank reconciliations. Investment reconciliations and liaising with banks/asset managers accordingly. Processing of day to day transactional accounting entries. Processing of month/quarter end accounting journals. Processing bespoke daily and weekly reporting such as investment reports. Preparation of month/quarter end management accounts. Preparation of annual financial statements. Assisting with external audit queries. Preparation of Isle of Man corporation tax returns. Other relevant projects from time to time as required. Provide cover for other members of the team during times of holiday and illness. Key Skills and Experience have experience of day to day journal entries, bank reconciliations, payments, accruals, prepayments, supplier control accounts. have experience in the preparation of management accounts and financial statements for Isle of Man Companies. Knowledge of the Paxus fund accounting system (primary accounting system used) and Sage accounts would be an advantage, but not essential as training will be provided. The successful candidate will be joining a small team supported by the Directors. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16808

Community Support Worker – East & South.
LV Home Care is looking for a Community Support Worker to join our lovely and dedicated team in the East and South, providing 
high-quality domiciliary care to our clients.
We are looking for enthusiastic, compassionate, respectful, honest and caring individuals with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
As a Community Support Worker, you will support our clients to remain safely and comfortably in their own homes, assisting them with a variety of tasks, including:
Personal care, Medication administration, Meal preparation, Light household tasks, Accompanying clients to appointments and shopping, Welfare checks.
Companionship.
We are committed to delivering the highest standards of person-centred care and striving for excellence to enrich the lives of our clients.
Previous qualifications and experience are preferred but not essential, as full training will be provided.
Applicants must have a full driving licence and access to their own vehicle. An Enhanced DBS check is required for this role and will 
be processed by LV once the position has been offered.

Competitive rates of pay, 4 weeks’ pro-rata paid holiday, Mileage paid in addition to your hourly rate, 24/7 support from our management team.
Sign-on bonus for successful applicants. Eligibility to join the Company Pension Scheme after successfully completing your probationary period
Health Plan entitlement after successfully completing your probationary period.

At LV, we work to empower our employees so they can achieve more. We ensure our team has the freedom, support and resources they need to make a real 
difference in the care industry. Come and join our very supportive and friendly team! To apply, please send your CV to Jen at jen@lv.care.
Alternatively, if you would like an informal chat about the role, please call 855382.

Notes
Rentokil Pest Control Technician:
Join Our Team and Make a Difference!
We are currently seeking a Pest Control Technician to join our dedicated team at the covering Isle of Man.  No prior experience required as we provide comprehensive, industry-leading training. If you enjoy managing your own schedule and solving unique customer problems in person, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
Why Join Rentokil?
Competitive Salary Package: Start with a basic salary of £27,669 per annum.
Expected OTE: £32,000 per annum, with bonus and commission schemes available.
Benefits: Company vehicle, fuel card, mobile phone, uniform, and RI Rewards.
Relocation Package: Moving from more than 2 hours away? We may offer up to £5,000 to help you settle in.
Work-Life Balance: Full-time, permanent role, Monday to Friday (40 hr week), with potential for up to 48 hours in the future with an increased salary.
Industry-Leading Training: Receive top-notch training to support our customers’ pest control needs.

The Role:
Your role as a Pest Control Technician will involve covering a dedicated geographical area and providing support to our customers by resolving their pest issues. Key responsibilities include: 
Inspecting customer premises for signs of pests and identifying potential risks.
Swiftly tackling pest problems by cleaning and removing evidence of pest behaviour.
Offering valuable advice to customers on the maintenance and hygiene of their premises.
Completing accurate reports after every visit.
Providing exceptional customer service and upholding a professional image at all times.
Full UK driving licence held for more than two years, with no more than six penalty points.
Educated to GCSE (or equivalent) in Maths and English at level C (Grade 4) or above is advantageous.
Demonstrate excellent customer service and communication skills.
Flexibility with working patterns to support business needs.
You may be required to pass a DBS check depending on the role you have applied for.

For more details and to apply contact https://apply.workable.com/rentokil-initial-group/j/DA353D599B

Applicants should hold a current pre-hospital care qualification appropriate to the role, such as First Response Emergency Care (FREC) 4 or equivalent for Emergency Care Assistants, an IHCD Ambulance Technician or (FREC 5), a Level 4 Diploma for Associate Ambulance Practitioners.

Experience in a healthcare, emergency care or event medical setting is essential, along with the ability to care for patients safely within your scope of practice, good communication and teamwork skills, accurate record keeping, and a sound understanding of infection control, safeguarding and confidentiality. You must be able to stay calm under pressure and be willing to work flexibly including evenings, weekends and events. 

Satisfactory enhanced disclosure and barring checks are essential and will be required as a condition of employment. Existing right to work on the Isle of Man is desirable, but applicants who do not hold it may still apply, as the company can apply for a work permit where required. 

A full driving licence and a C1 driving licence (or willingness to undertake this) are also desirable.
An Emergency Response Ambulance Driving Qualification for example the Level 3 Certificate In Emergency Response Ambulance Driving, is essential.

Notes
The Community Support Worker is responsible for providing high-quality person-centred care and support to service users in their own homes. This role involves assisting service users with personal care, daily living activities, and promoting their independence and well-being. The Community Support Worker will work closely with service users, their families, and other care professionals to deliver personalised care services.

Key Responsibilities:
To assist service users with personal care tasks such as bathing, dressing and continence care. Support with mobility, including the use of aids and adaptations as required. Ensure that service users’ dignity and privacy are always maintained during personal care activities. Administer medication to service users according to their care plans and in line with company policies and procedures. Assist service users with meal preparation and hydration, ensuring that dietary needs are met.

You may be asked to help service users with light household tasks such as cleaning, laundry, and shopping, as needed. Accompany service users to appointments, social activities, and other outings to promote their social well-being. Encourage service users to engage in activities that promote their physical, emotional, and mental well-being. 

Foster a supportive environment that enables service users to achieve their goals and maintain their independence. Provide emotional support and companionship to service users. Observe and report any changes in service users’ physical or mental health to the Care Coordinator or Care Manager. Facilitate clear and effective communication between care staff, service users, and other professionals.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of care provided, including daily logs and incident reports. Ensure that any concerns regarding service users’ safety or well-being are promptly communicated and documented. Participate in ongoing training and development to maintain and enhance your skills and knowledge. Stay up to date with best practices in domiciliary care and any relevant legislative changes.

We support opportunities for personal and professional growth within the role. No previous experience required as full training will be provided and you must have the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

Key Skills and Attributes:
Compassionate and caring nature with a strong commitment to supporting vulnerable individuals. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
Ability to work flexibly and respond to changing needs. 
Physical ability to assist clients with mobility and personal care tasks. 
Respect for diversity and cultural differences.

Additional Requirements:
Satisfactory enhanced DBS check.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and bank holidays.

Working Hours: Monday to Friday mornings and alternate weekends.

For more details and to apply contact office@ablecare.im or 01624 897813.

Align 4 Life is a state-of-the-art family chiropractic, spine and posture clinic, dedicated to helping people of all ages improve their health, wellbeing and quality of life.

We're looking for an enthusiastic, organised and personable Head of Clinic Administration to play a key role in our growing team. We need someone who is reliable, energetic, highly organised and people-focused, with excellent communication skills and attention to detail.
Previous administration experience is essential, with team leadership or supervisory experience advantageous. Confidence with computers and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace is required. Experience in corporate, hospitality or customer-focused environments is beneficial.
This is a varied and fast-paced position for someone who enjoys working with people and is confident taking responsibility for leading the administrative operation while supporting front-of-house and the wider clinic team.
Key Responsibilities: 
Lead the day-to-day administration and organisation of the clinic; manage patient appointments, diaries, enquiries and correspondence; maintain accurate records, databases, stats and documentation; support management and the HR team; help manage supplies, equipment and office organisation; support front desk to welcome patients and visitors and provide an exceptional experience; answer calls and emails professionally; support the wider clinic team and help improve operational efficiency.
What We Offer:
Full 4-week initial training, free chiropractic care, ongoing training and personal development, career growth opportunities, staff incentives and competitions, a positive, energetic working environment and the opportunity to work in a Chiropractic Biophysics clinic — one of only five in the UK.

Apply with your CV and covering letter to neil@align4life.com 
Please also phone and leave a brief message (30 secs only) as to why you think you would be a great asset to the Align 4 Life team on the following number:
01624 678598 
(N.B. Emailed applications will only be considered if a phone message is also left.)

Notes
We are seeking friendly and resilient Additional Support Workers to join us across all our services. We have over 9 different houses located both in Eastern and Central parts of the Island where they are located within easy reach of local bus routes. You will be joining a friendly, established team that provides quality support to autistic adults.

We are looking for people who will bring their passion and enthusiasm to the role. Autism Initiatives provide specialist support for people with autism and we are committed to working in partnership to achieve the best possible outcomes.

As an Additional Support Worker you will support with a range of activities which meet the wishes of the people that we support and encourages people with autism to live as independently as possible and be part of their local community. Activities could include: swimming, accessing day trips, gardening, walking groups and many more.

The role of an Additional Support Worker enables you to accept shifts around your availability and other commitments. If you are looking for some variety, flexibility in hours and are keen to make a difference, please get in touch today!

This is a truly rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills and knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

We are seeking an enthusiastic and dynamic Registered Service Manager who has the drive and passion to develop a service and team to achieve success. The successful candidate will demonstrate integrity, compassion, and real commitment to working with Autism Initiatives as we progress through the next stage of our Adult Supported Living Service.

You will lead and motivate the team to develop the overall quality of the service including individualised approaches, outcome focused support planning, contract management, finance, health and safety and staffing. The successful candidate will provide regular supervisions, guidance and direction to the team. To be successful in this role, you will have the ability to deliver a highly personalised service to adults with a diagnosis of ASC and actively encourage community access for service user’s and enable active participation in a variety of activities to increase their independence and live successful as a valued member of the community.

You will have experience inworking in a Health and Social Care setting and be able to evidence your contribution to positive outcomes for service users and your ability to fulfil this important role.

Ideally you will hold a Level 5 Health and Social Care qualification, or you will be required to obtain this qualification on successful appointment.

For more information, or to apply, please visit autisminitiatives.org.

Join a brilliant team on the Isle of Man, committed to supporting autistic people to live as independently as possible and to be part of their local community. Autism Initiatives work positively alongside people with autism, providing specialist services that are tailored to each individual.

We are seeking friendly Support Workers to join us at our Residential services. We have a number of houses located in Central and Northern parts of the Island within easy reach of local bus routes.

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic and will enjoy joining a team that encourages people with autism to enjoy an active lifestyle. Community activities could include swimming, accessing walking groups or trips to the cinema or even camping trips and gorge walking. Support Workers promote health and well-being and support individuals to maintain their home. The support we deliver is flexible and unique to each individual, building on their strengths and driven by their goals.

Experience is not essential, but a genuine desire to making a difference to the lives of people with autism, as well as a positive attitude is. This is truly a rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills, knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

We are looking for a friendly, outgoing and reliable Café & Deli Assistant to join a growing team following an exciting rebrand.

Serving customers across the café and deli counter.
Preparing and serving hot meals, breakfast items and fresh deli products.
Keeping the kitchen and service areas clean, organised and hygienic.
Working closely with the team to deliver a great customer experience.

Requirements:

Café or kitchen experience preferred, although a love of cooking and willingness to learn are welcome.
Level 2 Food Hygiene qualification required.
Friendly, approachable and confident with customers.
Able to multitask and remain calm in a busy environment.
Available to start work at 7am.

Full training will be provided.

Hours: 42 hours per week, including one Saturday per month.

Applicants must be aged 21 or over.

Benefits: Good rates of pay, plus free breakfast and lunch.

If you enjoy working with people and take pride in serving great food, we’d love to hear from you!

Notes
Smoky Sam’s BBQ is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Restaurant Supervisor to join our team.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about great food, excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for both our customers and our team. As a Restaurant Supervisor, you’ll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the restaurant and helping to make sure every customer has a fantastic experience.

You’ll be responsible for supervising the team during shifts, ensuring the restaurant is running smoothly and maintaining our high standards of service, cleanliness and food quality. You’ll lead by example, support and motivate team members, and help create a friendly and welcoming environment.

The ideal person will have previous experience in a restaurant, hospitality or supervisory role, although we’re also happy to consider someone with the right attitude, personality and willingness to learn. You’ll need to be confident communicating with both customers and staff, able to stay calm and organised during busy periods, and comfortable taking responsibility when required.

You’ll help with opening and closing the restaurant, managing shifts, supporting the team during busy services, dealing with customer queries and resolving any issues professionally. You’ll also work closely with management to ensure company standards and procedures are followed.

We believe our team is just as important as the food we serve. We’re looking for someone who is reliable, approachable, hardworking and enjoys being part of a team. If you’re someone who takes pride in your work and wants to help us continue providing great food and great service, we’d love to hear from you.
 Please send a copy of your CV and a small bit about yourself and why you would be a great fit at Smoky Sam's to smokysamsbbq@gmail.com

Your main responsibilities will include keeping the kitchen, equipment and work areas clean and tidy, washing dishes and kitchen equipment, helping with deliveries and putting stock away, keeping the pot wash area organised and supporting the chefs with general kitchen tasks when required. You’ll also help maintain our high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and food safety throughout the kitchen.

We’re looking for someone who is hardworking, reliable and takes pride in keeping things clean and organised. You’ll need to be comfortable working in a busy kitchen environment and able to work well as part of a team. Hospitality or kitchen experience is preferred but isn’t essential, as the right attitude and willingness to learn are just as important to us.

Smoky Sam’s can be a fast-paced environment, especially during busy services, so you’ll need to be able to work under pressure, keep a positive attitude and be willing to get stuck in wherever needed.

We’re proud of our team and believe that every role in the kitchen is important. If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, develop your skills and become part of a friendly and hardworking team, we’d love to hear from you. 
Please email a copy of your CV to smokysamsbbq@gmail.com

Cafe 360 at the Isle of Man Business Park, Douglas, is growing and we're creating a new full-time General Manager role to help lead it into its next chapter. As a Commis Chef, you will act as the foundational support for our kitchen operations. You will be responsible for preparing ingredients, assisting across various stations, and maintaining our high standards of kitchen cleanliness and food safety while developing your culinary skills. Assisting senior chefs with daily food preparation, including washing, peeling, chopping, and portioning ingredients. Supporting the hot and cold lines during service by helping with basic cooking, assembly, and precise plating. Receiving, inspecting, organising, and rotating stock deliveries in accordance with food storage guidelines. Maintaining a clean, sanitary, and safe workstation throughout the shift and completing deep-cleaning tasks at close. Adhering strictly to health, hygiene, and safety regulations at all times. Prior experience working in a professional kitchen environment or a relevant culinary qualification. Basic knowledge of food safety principles and kitchen hygiene. The ability to stand for long periods and thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. A strong work ethic, punctuality, and a genuine eagerness to learn and grow within the culinary team.

For more details and to apply contact smashnfry@gmail.com

We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised Events Coordinator to join our Food & Beverage team at Comis Hotel & Golf Resort.
You will coordinate weddings, corporate events and special occasions, working closely with clients and hotel departments to deliver exceptional experiences at our four-star resort.
Key Responsibilities:
Plan and coordinate events from initial enquiry through to completion.
Liaise with clients, suppliers and internal departments to ensure successful event delivery.

Commercial awareness and confidence working with clients and suppliers.
Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience using event management software is advantageous.
Flexible to work evenings, weekends and bank holidays according to event schedules.

Competitive salary, service charge participation, staff meals and uniform, hotel discounts, employee recognition schemes, free on-site parking and career development opportunities.

Taste Buds has been established for 40 years and provides delicious, high-quality home cooked fresh foods, coffee and outside catering services from our friendly, family run Douglas Sandwich Bar, Kitchen and Shop.
We are looking for an additional person to join our team who is bright, loves cooking and has a cheerful personality.

The job would be ideal for someone who is an experienced home cook who enjoys helping people and likes variety in their work. If this sounds like you, join us and become part of the family.   

This is a mixed role involving our kitchen and buffet food preparation, serving our lovely customers at lunchtimes and clearing after service.  Working hours to be mutually agreed will be around 07.30 am to 2.45 pm (Mon – Fri). This is a Monday – Friday permanent role (i.e. non-seasonal & no split shifts).

An excellent standard and understanding of verbal and written English is required to enable instructions from customers to be completed accurately. We would welcome applications from experienced individuals, however we can also train you in any areas required. 

Our business is geared to the corporate market and therefore our food must always go out on time, which means we need 100% reliability with your time keeping and attendance. You’ll be smart and clean in your appearance. Please do not apply if your time keeping or attendance will not be 100% reliable due to personal or health reasons. We are a non-smoking food company and therefore you are not allowed to smoke during working hours.
   
To apply, please e-mail your CV to callum@tastebuds.im, or pop into the shop – Taste Buds, 5 – 6 Railway Shops, Peel Road, Douglas to collect a job application form.

Notes
We’re looking for chefs who takes pride in producing great food, enjoys working as part of a team and thrives in a busy kitchen environment. You’ll be working alongside our kitchen management team to help deliver the high-quality food that Smoky Sam’s is known for.

As a CDP or Sous Chef, you’ll be responsible for running your section to a high standard, preparing and cooking food consistently, maintaining excellent food hygiene and safety standards and helping to ensure every dish leaving the kitchen meets our expectations.

You’ll be expected to take responsibility for your section, including preparation, stock rotation, ordering and maintaining a clean and organised workstation. You’ll also help support junior members of the kitchen team, communicate effectively during service and work closely with the senior kitchen team to keep services running smoothly.

For the right person, this role can offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility and progress within the business. We’re looking for someone who wants to develop their skills, is confident working under pressure and is willing to lead by example.

Previous professional kitchen experience is essential, with CDP or Sous Chef experience preferred. Experience working in a busy restaurant environment would be a strong advantage. BBQ experience isn’t essential, but a genuine passion for food and willingness to learn our style of cooking is a must.
We’re looking for someone who is reliable, organised and passionate about hospitality. You’ll need to be a strong team player with a positive attitude and the ability to stay calm and focused during busy services.

If you’re looking for your next challenge and want to be part of a growing BBQ restaurant with a strong team and plenty of opportunity to develop, we’d love to hear from you.

Please Email smokysamsbbq@gmail.com with a copy of your CV

https://apogeecorp.ciphr-irecruit.com/applicants/vacancy/818/1st-Line-Support-Technician

JOB DETAILS

As a 1st Line Helpdesk Technician, you will be the first point of contact for customers needing support with IT, hardware, software and network-related issues.

You will handle incoming support requests, diagnose problems, provide remote support where possible, and escalate more complex issues to the right team when needed. This is a customer-focused role, so keeping clients updated and delivering a helpful, professional service is key.

The role will involve:

Responding to customer support requests by phone, email or ticketing system.
Logging, managing and updating support tickets accurately.
Providing first-line troubleshooting for laptops, desktops, applications, servers and network issues.
Using remote access tools to investigate and resolve IT faults.
Keeping customers informed on progress and agreed next steps.
Escalating issues where they cannot be resolved at first point of contact.
Supporting service levels by responding to issues promptly and professionally.
A typical working pattern is Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:30, with a one-hour lunch break. This role also offers flexibility to work from home, typically two days per week for a five-day working week once training is complete.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Experience supporting customers with IT, hardware or software issues.
Good understanding of laptops, desktops, basic networking and common IT applications.
Confident troubleshooting skills across Windows PCs, Macs, printers or connected devices.
Knowledge of basic network terms such as IP addressing, DNS and routing.
Experience using remote support or ticketing tools would be useful.
Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.
A practical approach to problem solving and knowing when to escalate issues.
We value candidates with AI literacy – individuals who are curious about technology, comfortable exploring automation, and eager to contribute to a modern, forward-thinking business.

Notes
An opportunity has arisen for a Citizen IT Developer to work in a team reporting to the Senior Product Owner. The successful candidates will have an important role in creating, implementing and supporting low code applications to streamline and enhance business processes. 

The main responsibilities for the role holder will include:

Analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improving efficiency and effectiveness.
Design user interfaces and workflows using data models with low-code platforms, ensuring alignment with business goals.
Design and implement data models, ensuring accurate representation of business data within applications. Implement data validation and verification processes and audit trail.
Create automated workflows and business process automations using low-code platforms (e.g. Microsoft Power Platform products / Xceptor).
Integrate applications or processes with other systems, databases, or APIs as needed for seamless data flow.
Conduct testing of developed solutions to identify and address issues or improvements. Debug and troubleshoot problems to ensure the reliability of applications.
Collaborate with IT professionals, business analysts, and stakeholders to ensure the successful deployment and adoption of solutions.
Provide training to end-users on how to effectively use the deployed applications.

The successful candidate will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

Demonstrate good problem-solving skills with the ability to analyse business processes and design effective solutions.
Ability to write custom code or scripts when necessary, using languages like Power Query / JavaScript / Azure functions for use by Power Platform solutions
Good understanding of data structures, databases, and application architecture
Experience of delivering business improvements and efficiencies.
Understanding of end-users' needs and the ability to design solutions that enhance user experience
Ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels within the company and with outsource partners.
Ability to adapt to evolving technology and understand benefits they can bring to support business.
Working knowledge of Agile methodology.

Ideally the applicant will be/have:

Proficient in the Microsoft Office suite.
Proficient in Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI or Power Apps, Xceptor or equivalent products.
Keen interest in technology and a willingness to learn and contribute to digital solutions.

If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position please forward current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com.

The closing date for this vacancy will be 14 October 2026.

Notes
We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Promotions Strategy & Optimisation Manager to drive the performance of promotions, campaigns and bonuses across our Sportsbook and Casino products.
Key Responsibilities
Promotions & Performance Optimisation:
Lead the optimisation of promotions, campaigns and bonus activity across Sportsbook and Casino.  Analyse performance to understand which offers and mechanics are delivering against their objectives.  Identify inefficient or underperforming activity and recommend improvements to targeting, mechanics, rewards and timing.
Identify opportunities to scale or further improve successful promotions.   Define and monitor KPIs including promotional cost, participation, conversion, retention, engagement and player value.  Assess the incremental impact of promotional activity to understand the true value generated.  Establish a strong test-and-learn approach using A/B testing, control groups and experimentation.
Personalisation & Automation:
Work with CRM, BI, Product and other teams to improve promotional targeting and personalisation.  Identify opportunities to use player behaviour, preferences and value to determine the most relevant offer, reward and timing.  Support the development of automated promotional decision-making and personalised journeys.
Explore how predictive models and machine learning can improve promotional effectiveness.  Define success measures and continuously evaluate automated activity.
Innovation & Collaboration:
Keep up to date with developments in Sportsbook and Casino promotions, bonusing and player engagement.  Monitor competitor activity and identify new mechanics, capabilities and opportunities.  Bring new ideas to the Promotions team and challenge existing approaches where data suggests there is a better way.
Work closely with Promotions, CRM, BI and Product to turn insights into practical improvements.  The above duties provide a generic description of the Employee’s day to day responsibilities but should in no way be deemed to be an exhaustive list. Additional related, duties may be assigned by the Line Manager in line with business exigencies and continuity.
What We're Looking For:
Experience in promotions, bonusing, CRM, commercial analytics, player analytics or a related optimisation role.  Experience within Sportsbook, Casino, iGaming or a similar digital industry.  A highly analytical and data-driven mindset with strong commercial judgement.  Experience evaluating campaign or promotional performance against clear objectives.  A strong understanding of segmentation, targeting and personalisation.  Experience with experimentation and test-and-learn methodologies.
An understanding of how automation and machine learning can support marketing and promotional decision-making.  The ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.  Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

For more details and to apply contact talent@silverspin.com or 07624269891.

Science Club Leader

We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative and responsible person to join the Fun Science team as a Science Club Leader.

The successful candidate will lead fun, hands-on science activities and experiments during our after-school and holiday clubs. All activities, equipment and training will be provided, so you do not need to be a science expert - just enthusiastic about working with children and excited to get stuck in!

The role involves:

Leading science activities and experiments with groups of young children.
Explaining activities clearly and ensuring children follow safety instructions.
Managing a group of children and responding confidently to different situations.
Setting up and clearing away equipment and keeping the activity area tidy.
Ensuring children are supervised and leave safely with their responsible adult.

The position would ideally suit someone with previous experience of working with children or young people. We are particularly looking for someone who demonstrates initiative, good judgement, confidence and enthusiasm, and who can take charge when needed.

As part of the interview process, candidates will be asked to give examples of situations where they have:

Taken initiative to complete a task without being asked.
Used their judgement to deal with a challenging or delicate situation.
Demonstrated responsibility when working with children or young people.

Clubs are held at various times and locations across the Isle of Man. After-school clubs generally take place during weekday afternoons, after the school day has finished, while holiday clubs take place during school holidays. A full driving licence and access to your own vehicle is preferred, as travel between different venues may be required.

An enhanced DBS check will be completed for the successful candidate.

Due to the nature of the role, which involves responsibility for children and working with substances that may be hazardous if handled incorrectly, candidates must be over 18 years of age, in accordance with the Employment of Children Regulations 2018.

To apply, please send your CV and a brief covering statement, along with details of two recent referees, to isleofman@fun-science.org.uk.

Notes
Job Role – Ground Security Officer
Our Aviation Security Team at the Isle of Man Airport gets the training they need to excel at what they do. We don't believe in one-size-fits-all approaches and you will get hands on coaching and mentoring. We assess what our team actually faces day-to-day and make sure everyone has the right skills for the job. It's about looking after each other and making sure you feel confident and prepared in your role.
What Nobody Tells You – The Good
You’ll develop instincts that serve you everywhere in life.
The moment you pass certification is a genuine high.
Progressing from observation to solo operation builds real confidence.
The satisfaction of smooth operations is surprisingly addictive.
Your teammates become a second family (shift work bonds are real).
Skills you gain here are transferable globally.
The passengers you protect will rarely thank you. They won’t know the threats you’ve prevented or the situations you’ve defused. But every flight that lands safely, every reunion at arrivals, every business deal completed – you made that possible.
What We Need
The role of an Aviation Security Officer requires you to be self-motivated and disciplined, with a need to be physically fit as there is a small amount of lifting required.
Hours of work are split into shifts, an Early Shift and a Late Shift. Your Team will be working two lates followed by two early shifts, and then two days off.
You will be required to be vetted, with a full 5-year background check, and apply through our sponsorship for a Criminal Records Check.
What We Provide
We provide full two week classroom training to give you the theory for the role, followed by a period of On-the-Job training that develops your practical skill set.
You will be provided with a full uniform to look smart and professional
Holiday entitlement is 28 days per annum.
Please apply using the below link; 
https://careers.bidvestnoonan.com/vacancies/26107/security-officer.html

Notes
IFGL is seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Due Diligence Specialist & Legal Support professional to join our Risk, Legal & Compliance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in corporate due diligence, legal administration, or company secretarial support who is looking to develop their career within a professional financial services environment.

Reporting to the Data Protection Officer & Legal Specialist, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date corporate due diligence records for IFGL legal entities. You will work closely with relationship owners across the business to manage and review third-party due diligence requests and ensure appropriate documentation is supplied consistently and accurately.

You will also provide broader legal and governance support, including assistance with board resolutions, governance committee administration, and minute taking.

The main duties for the role holder will include:
Maintain current and accurate records of corporate due diligence documentation. 
Review, approve, and record non-standard due diligence responses. 
Respond to internal and external due diligence queries in a timely manner. 
Conduct regular reviews of due diligence records to ensure accuracy and compliance. 
Support internal stakeholders with guidance on due diligence requirements and documentation standards. 
Assist the wider Group Legal Team with data protection and corporate governance activities. 
Prepare board resolutions and provide minute-taking support for governance committees.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidates will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
Good understanding of corporate legal structures. 
Excellent attention to detail and ability to work accurately under pressure. 
Strong organisational and planning skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Ideally has minimum of two years’ experience within a company secretarial, legal support, or financial services environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Why Join IFGL?
At IFGL, you will be part of a collaborative and professional environment where your contribution is valued. This role offers exposure across multiple areas of legal, governance, and compliance activity within an established international financial services group.
If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward your current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com
We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.
The closing date for this vacancy will be 16 October 2026.

Notes
Our client seeks a TCSP Compliance Officer to join their team on a part-time basis. Subject to regulatory approval, and after adequate training and familiarisation, the role holder will ultimately hold the following statutory positions: Compliance Officer, under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book. Ideally, Money Laundering Reporting Officer, under the IOM AML/CFT Code 2019. You must be able to satisfy the IOM FSA on competence, time commitment, accessibility and effective oversight. An initial familiarisation period may be agreed before specific statutory positions are formally transferred. Key Responsibilities: Discharge the statutory Compliance Officer role under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book, acting as primary point of contact with the IOM FSA. Maintain compliance monitoring programme, regulatory returns, statutory registers, policy suite and the authorisation of new SPV structures. Oversee periodic client reviews and approve higher-risk new business across the SPV book. Ideally hold the MLRO function, receive internal reports, liaise with the IOM Financial Intelligence Unit. Run group sanctions screening (OFSI, OFAC, EU, UN), customer due diligence and transaction monitoring proportionate to the group's exposure, with particular attention to maritime risk. Deliver annual AML/CFT training to employees and report to the relevant boards on financial crime risk. Maintain the compliance requirements and risk assessment suite, AML/CFT and policy suite, and report to the Board. Key Skills and Experience: Ideally minimum three years' compliance experience in regulated financial services. Working knowledge of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book and AML/CFT Code 2019. Recognised compliance qualification such as the ICA Diploma in Compliance, the CISI Diploma in Investment Compliance or equivalent. Based in the Isle of Man. Track record of direct FSA engagement. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16832

Senior Administrator – Condensed Job Description
Purpose:
Manage and service a portfolio of Companies and Trusts, acting as the primary relationship manager and ensuring high-quality client administration and service.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage a portfolio of Companies and Trusts, acting as the key client contact.
Oversee day-to-day administration, client requirements and credit control.
Prioritise urgent and time-sensitive client matters and ensure effective delivery.
Provide technical guidance and support to administrators and assist with team cover.
Maintain strong knowledge of Isle of Man company law, corporate governance, AML and relevant legislation.
Keep up to date with regulatory and industry developments and communicate key changes to the team.
Escalate issues and areas of concern to Directors in a timely manner.
Support business and client-related projects as required.
Maintain accurate records and timesheets and ensure work is completed efficiently and to a high standard.
Experience & Skills:

Minimum 5 years’ experience within a TCSP/Trust & Corporate Services environment.
Industry qualification or part-qualification (e.g. STEP, ICSA/CGI or ACCA) desirable.
Strong knowledge of Isle of Man Companies Act, corporate governance and AML requirements.
Excellent organisational, prioritisation and problem-solving skills.
Confident dealing with professional clients, senior management and high-net-worth individuals.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Self-motivated, reliable and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
Ability to mentor, support and motivate junior team members.

For more details and to apply contact epl.admin@epl.im or 01624615600.
