Notes
Our client seeks a diligent and detail-oriented Compliance Administrator to support the compliance framework. You will assist the Head of Compliance and Directors in ensuring that the business meets its statutory, regulatory, and internal governance obligations. Key Responsibilities: Assist with customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) checks for new and existing clients. Conduct periodic reviews of client files to ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and up to date. Perform screening of clients, beneficial owners, and connected parties. Support the identification and escalation of suspicious activity in line with internal procedures. Help maintain compliance registers, including breaches, complaints, PEPs, sanctions, and training logs. Assist in monitoring compliance with the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority's Regulatory and AML/CFT Frameworks. Support thematic reviews, and business risk assessments. Contribute to the preparation of compliance reports for the board. Assist in drafting, updating and maintaining compliance policies and procedures. Help ensure staff are aware of regulatory changes and internal policy updates. Respond to internal queries about compliance, CDD requirements, and regulatory obligations. Assist with onboarding processes and ongoing monitoring workflows. Support the Client Services team in improving data quality within Reverto. Key Skills and Experience: Essential: Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Good understanding of Isle of Man AML/CFT and regulatory expectations. Excellent organisational and time-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication abilities. Ability to work with confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office. 5 GCSEs or equivalent at grade C or above. Desirable: Experience within a TCSP, fiduciary, or financial services environment. Familiarity with IOMFSA Rulebook, AML/CFT Code, and relevant legislation. Working knowledge of screening tools and Reverto. Progress toward a relevant qualification (for example, certificate in regulation, AML or Trust Estate Practitioner). 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16851

Notes
AML ANALYST
We currently have permanent positions available within the Customer Services AML Team.

Reporting to the AML Remediation Team Leader, the roles primarily support the Company’s AML/CFT defence by undertaking new and scheduled risk assessments along with supporting client responses to outstanding KYC requests.

The main duties for the role holders will include:
Support the Company’s AML/CTF defence by undertaking screening and risk assessments of the client base to identify any links to PEPs, sanctions, adverse media and financial crime.
Work closely with the wider AML team to ensure our AML/CTF obligations are met and will build strong relationships with our Regions and local business areas where required.
Maintain PEP and Higher Risk registers to include preparation of periodic updates and reconciliations.
Raising SARs as and when required.
Identifying and remediating changes to client risk profiles identified by overnight risk calculation tool.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidates will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

An understanding of the Isle of Man’s regulatory AML framework.
Experience of using screening software such as World-Check, Dow Jones or Moody’s Grid.
Previous employment history within the financial crime function of a regulated financial services company.
Ideally holds an ICA AML qualification.
Demonstrate practical experience of working on AML remediation projects such as risk rating and obtaining EDD.

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com 

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

Closing date for this vacancy will be 23 October 2026.

Simcocks Advocates is seeking a conscientious and well-organised Conveyancing Administrator to join our Conveyancing Department. This role involves providing essential administrative support to the team, ensuring the efficient and accurate progression of property transactions and maintaining the high standards of professionalism for which our firm is known.

The successful candidate will be responsible for opening new matters, preparing and issuing letters of engagement, and accurately inputting and maintaining client information within the Conveyancing systems. They will collate, scan, and record client  documentation for sign-off, and assist in preparing searches and Land Registry applications. The role will also include supporting the team with the drafting of documents and undertaking additional administrative duties as required to assist with the smooth operation of the wider department.

We are delighted to be working with an established specialist investment management firm who are seeking an experienced Compliance Officer / MLRO to join their team on a part-time basis, approximately 2.5 days per week. This is an excellent opportunity for a compliance professional with investment management experience to take responsibility for a key regulatory function within an established business. The successful candidate will be responsible for the Isle of Man compliance function, ensuring the business continues to meet its regulatory obligations. The firm is regulated by the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority (IOMFSA) as an Investment Manager and also operates within a US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) regulated environment. The role will focus primarily on Isle of Man regulatory requirements, with external specialist support already in place for US SEC compliance matters. Previous SEC experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Key Responsibilities: Act as Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for Isle of Man regulated activities. Maintain and oversee the compliance framework in line with IOMFSA requirements. Provide compliance advice and guidance to the business. Review, update and maintain compliance policies, procedures and controls. Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant changes. Oversee AML/CFT obligations and ensure appropriate controls remain in place. Support regulatory reporting and compliance monitoring activities. Work alongside external advisers supporting US SEC compliance requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Previous experience within investment management compliance. Experience working within a regulated financial services environment. Experience acting as a Compliance Officer and/or MLRO. Strong understanding of AML/CFT requirements and regulatory frameworks. The ability to work independently and manage a broad compliance remit. Strong communication skills with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders. Experience within asset management, hedge funds or investment firms would be highly desirable.

Role Profile: To manage and coordinate all administrative requirements and duties across the project to ensure all project stakeholders are fully equipped to perform their required project roles and to ensure effective governance and availability of information. Key Responsibilities: Complete minutes for project meetings, obtain approval and sign-off of minutes from meeting chair and distribute minutes to meeting participants. Monitor the actioning of minute items to ensure agreed deadlines are met. Conduct financial and budget management duties across the project, including the updating of budgets with actuals, reconciling the financial entries against project budgets, the processing of invoices and claims and highlighting any financial discrepancies identified to ensure sound project financial management and reporting. Conduct onboarding and off boarding for all support staff, contractors and vendors to ensure they are fully equipped with the required information, access and hardware to fully exercise the requirements of their role within the project. Coordinate project workflow, activities and schedules across all project team members to ensure workload is effectively managed and deadlines are met. Drive and maintain the projects documentation management system to ensure that all project documentation is adequately and securely stored, version control is maintained and formats are adhered to, therefore enabling project governance and ensuring all project information is easily accessible. Key Skills and Experience: Diploma in Project Management. 3 - 4 years experience in Business Support role/environment. Experience in end-to-end administrative and secretarial duties across a programme or project environment, this includes documentation management, diary management and budget administration.

The successful candidate will provide a combination of personal, administrative and property management support. Notes
We are looking for an experienced, caring and reliable Nanny to join a busy and welcoming family on the Isle of Man.

The family has six children, five of whom are school-aged and attend school during the day. The youngest child is 2 years old and is at home during the day, so the role will primarily involve caring for the youngest child during school hours, alongside supporting the wider family routine before and after school.

Our preferred working arrangement is Monday to Friday, approximately 7am–7pm, on a one-week-on, one-week-off basis. This provides the successful candidate with every alternate week away from work.

However, we appreciate that experienced childcare professionals are in high demand and are happy to consider alternative working patterns or hours for the right candidate. We would therefore encourage applicants to get in touch even if they are unable to accommodate the preferred schedule.

Responsibilities will include providing attentive and engaging care for the youngest child, supporting morning and after-school routines, preparing children's meals and snacks where required, helping with children's laundry and organisation, assisting with school and activity arrangements, and generally helping to ensure the children's day-to-day routines run smoothly.

We are looking for someone who is warm, patient and confident caring for children of different ages. The successful candidate should be organised, dependable and proactive, with the ability to use their own initiative while working as part of a busy family household.

Previous professional childcare or nannying experience would be highly desirable. Relevant childcare qualifications and paediatric first-aid training would also be advantageous.

A full driving licence would be beneficial due to the nature of the role.

We offer a competitive rate of pay, dependent upon experience and the working arrangements agreed with the successful candidate.

To apply, please send your CV to allison@trillionmediagroup.com together with a short introduction outlining your childcare experience, availability and preferred working arrangements.

Are you a commercially minded Business Analyst who thrives on turning ideas into clear requirements and measurable business value? We have an exciting opportunity to join our Group Change Department and play a key role in shaping and delivering change across the business. You will work with project managers, delivery teams, stakeholders and third-party partners to define outcomes, prioritise value and support successful delivery from discovery through to implementation.

The main responsibilities for the role holder will include:

Shaping compelling business cases and clear problem statements that focus delivery on measurable business value and customer outcomes.
Mapping as-is and to-be processes, identifying gaps, dependencies, risks and opportunities for operational improvement.
Eliciting, analysing and documenting clear business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and supporting artefacts for agile and hybrid delivery teams.
Conducting data analysis to uncover opportunities and inform decisions.
Completing gap analysis, impact assessments and options analysis to support informed decision-making and delivery planning.
Providing business analysis support across software development, testing, data migration, upgrades, release readiness and implementation activity.
Collaborating closely with business users, project managers, IT teams, third parties and outsource providers to maintain alignment and delivery momentum.
Supporting sprint refinement, backlog prioritisation, UAT planning, test preparation and business validation to ensure solutions are ready for adoption.
Helping teams embed change by supporting communication, training, adoption planning and continuous improvement.
Mentoring junior members of the team and contributing to best practice within the change team.

Notes
Are you an experienced life and disability claims executive looking for your next challenge?

At IFGL, we're looking for a knowledgeable and commercially minded claims professional to join our Underwriting team. You'll play a key role in assessing complex life and disability insurance claims, supporting underwriting best practice and helping to develop the technical capability of colleagues across the wider team.

This is more than a traditional processing role. Alongside assessing protection claims, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to underwriting and claims governance activities, support process improvements, work closely with reinsurers and help shape the ongoing development of our underwriting and claims philosophies.

The main responsibilities for the role holder will include:

Assessing life and disability insurance claims and determining appropriate requirements and sign off in line with company philosophy.
Reviewing complex and higher-risk cases, including referrals requiring advanced technical judgement.
Analysing claims documents including medical, financial, occupational and lifestyle information to evaluate risk.
Supporting underwriting governance activities, audits and quality assurance reviews.
Coaching and mentoring colleagues to enhance technical knowledge and capability.
Building effective relationships with reinsurers and other internal and external stakeholders.
Supporting automation, system enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate will need the following skills and experience:

A minimum of 5 years’ experience in life insurance underwriting and/or protection claims.
Strong technical knowledge and decision-making ability.
Experience assessing complex and higher-risk cases.
A sound understanding of underwriting philosophy, risk management and reinsurance principles.
Commercial awareness and excellent judgement.
Experience coaching or supporting the development of colleagues.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Good understanding of regulatory requirements, including Data Protection and Anti-Money Laundering obligations.
Professional qualifications such as ALU, ACII or Dip CII would be advantageous.
Strong Microsoft Office skills and excellent planning and organisational abilities.

If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position please forward your/their current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

The closing date for this vacancy will be 23 October 2026.

Notes
Our Client seeks a Client Support Officer to join their team. Role Profile: You will work as part of the Client support team, proactively assisting Client administration teams with their compliance with CDD requirements during the lifecycle of a client. Support client teams with the review of clients and client owners and also due diligence documentation and information ensuring all is compliant with regulatory and policy and procedure requirements for a full range of wealth structures ensuring that first class service is provided to Clients, the Client Directors and Administration Teams. In addition you will complete Risk Screen checks and Google searches to support client due diligence and risk management. Review new CDD documents to ensure they meet the standard required by the business and where appropriate, an assessment of the certifier will also be required as part of this review. Ensure that data is populated in NavOne and that the documents are scanned in Laserfiche and they must ensure they deliver on internal and Client commitments to agreed deadlines and to a high standard. The role holder may be requested to support the client administration teams and new business teams with ad hoc projects as required and appropriate to their skillset including but not limited to supporting the completion of data and obtaining data to support real estate risk. Key Skills and Experience: 2-5 years experience working in a similar support role. 2-5 years trust administration experience. The role holder is likely to be studying towards or hold a relevant professional qualification such as STEP or ICSA equivalent. Track record within the offshore financial services industry with experience of the administration of trust and company structures and experience in implemeting CDD policies and procedures in the review of client files. A good understanding of Anti Money Laundering, Countering the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation Financing legislation, codes of practice and regulatory guidance as well as industry best practice is essential...

For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number: 16581

Notes
Our client seeks an experienced Senior Client Services Administrator to join their team. The ideal candidate will have proven experience of working within a regulated environment for a Corporate Service Provider and confidently manage a portfolio of asset-owning companies. This role would suit someone who is driven to continually expand their knowledge and develop their skills, contributing positively to team and client success. Key Responsibilities: Manage and administer a portfolio of corporate entities, many of which are aircraft or yacht holding. Act as a key point of contact for clients, intermediaries, government departments, registries and stakeholders. Maintain statutory records and carry out all company secretarial duties including company incorporations/dissolutions, regulatory and statutory filings, completion of annual returns, arranging and attendance at board meetings, preparing minutes and resolutions. Complete VAT registration/de-registration, review VAT returns, liaise with tax and customs advisors. Review of transactional documents and agreements, coordinate legal advice and opinions. Open and operate company bank accounts including creating, verifying and authorising payments in accordance with internal payment procedures. Assist with onboarding new business, carrying out customer risk assessments and review of CDD, perform ongoing compliance and transaction monitoring. Responsible for monitoring and controlling client WIP, raising invoices and support debt collection. Stay up to date with latest legislation and best practice in relevant areas. Attend training events and further develop relevant knowledge and skills. Support team members during periods of leave and assist with training where appropriate. Key Skills & Experience: Previous experience of managing a client portfolio within a regulated Trust and Corporate Service Provider, with full ownership and accountability for client structures and relationships. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, applying sound professional judgement to resolve problems and communicate clear, decisive solutions, escalating where appropriate. Strong communication and organisational skills. An enthusiastic, proactive and adaptable approach to work. Self-motivated with a willingness to undertake further on the job training and continual personal development. Ideally, have an understanding of business aviation and/or yachting. A second language would be an advantage. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16362

Join us at Poundland during this festive period as a Seasonal Sales Assistant and help make the most magical shopping season of the year even brighter for our customers.

As one of Poundland's Elves on the shop floor, you’ll be a festive ambassador for our brand, creating a warm, welcoming, and merry shopping experience every day.

You’ll be part of a friendly and energetic team, keeping shelves stocked with all those essential items, delivering fantastic customer service, supporting deliveries, ensuring the checkouts run smoothly, and helping maintain a safe, tidy, and cheerful store environment.

We're looking for team players with a positive, can-do attitude and a friendly approach. Good organisation and attention to detail, especially when working on the tills, are essential. Previous retail or customer service experience is a bonus, but not a requirement. We’ll provide all the training you need to help you shine, because every member of our team plays an important part in making this, the most wonderful time of the year, a success.
 
This role will start soon and last until the end of December, and we may require you to work different shifts based on store needs, therefore flexibility is key.

Apply here: https://search.poundlanddealzcareers.com/vacancies/750/sales-assistant-christmas-temp.html

Location: Ballasalla, Isle of Man
Salary: £27,00.00 - £32,000.00 per annum Dependent on Experience
SOC Code: 3115
Closing Date: 31st October 2026
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Control Analyst to join our Quality Control team in the Isle of Man. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the testing and release of specialist products while supporting quality standards, laboratory operations and continuous improvement initiatives. This role offers exposure to a variety of analytical techniques and opportunities to develop within a regulated laboratory environment.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct testing of raw materials, intermediates and finished products, maintain laboratory records, perform environmental monitoring activities, support equipment maintenance and calibration, assist with investigations, train colleagues and contribute to continuous improvement activities.
About You
A degree in a scientific discipline is desirable, together with strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work independently. Previous laboratory experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or chemical manufacturing environment would be advantageous.
Working Environment
Laboratory-based role involving analytical testing, the use of laboratory equipment and adherence to quality and safety procedures. The role may require occasional flexibility to support operational requirements.
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work within a quality-focused environment, gain experience across a range of analytical techniques and products, and develop your skills through ongoing training and professional development.

If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity within a quality control environment, we would love to hear from you.
Closing Date: 31st October 2026.

Please apply via this link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8333782-qc-analyst-astrea
